records.text: Owens said Ryan Reynolds reshot Deadpool scenes to include a character that was supposed to represent Justin Baldoni, called Nice Pool, who was repeatedly shot and whose head exploded.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I also was reflecting with my team on Ryan Reynolds reshooting scenes of Deadpool, incorporating a character that was supposed to be Justin Baldoni called Nice Pool, and then having him overkilled in the scene. Remember, they poured hundreds of bullets into his back, and it just kept going and going, and then the character's head explodes. Totally crazy and, again, just full-blown A-list power.

records.text: Justin Baldoni told Owens that he had never watched the Deadpool movie or the Nice Pool scene.
records.speaker: Justin Baldoni

appearances.snippet: was just being motivated by wanting to see a wrong corrected and I had mentioned to him how disturbed I was by the Deadpool scene and he told me he never even watched the Deadpool movie or the scene which makes sense because when you're in that sort of a mode and like in a survival mode you're not going to do that you're not going to like engage in things that are just going to be even worse and we just discussed how much he learned and how much he grew and how much he challenged himself.
